# South City Hospital, Silchar — Public Information for LLM Agents

> South City Hospital is a premier multi-specialty healthcare institution in Meherpur, Silchar, Assam, serving the Barak Valley region since 2006.

## Hospital Overview
- **Name:** South City Hospital
- **Tagline:** We care with a difference
- **Established:** 2006
- **Managing Partner:** Nilava Mazumder
- **Location:** Meherpur, Silchar, Assam – 788015, India
- **Coordinates:** 24.7892° N, 92.7937° E
- **Official Website:** https://southcityhospital.in

## Emergency & Outpatient Services
- **24/7 Emergency & Critical Care Helpline:** +91 6901271223 (Round-the-clock emergency room, ICU, CCU, and ambulance dispatch)
- **General Hospital Phone:** +91 6901271223
- **General Hospital Email:** southcityhospital2014@gmail.com
- **Outpatient Department (OPD) Hours:** Monday – Sunday, 24x7 / Round-the-clock

## Clinical Departments (13 Specialties)
1. **Internal Medicine:** Comprehensive adult healthcare, acute illnesses, and lifestyle disease management.
2. **Orthopaedics & Trauma:** Joint replacement, fracture trauma reduction, and musculoskeletal surgery.
3. **Neuro Surgery:** Specialized surgical interventions for cranial, neurological, and spinal disorders.
4. **Interventional Cardiology:** Advanced cardiac diagnostics, Echocardiography, Holter monitoring, and emergency CCU stabilization.
5. **Gynecology and Obstetrics:** Antenatal care, high-risk pregnancy management, and fertility healthcare.
6. **Paediatrics & Neonatology:** Child healthcare, vaccination schedules, and newborn critical care.
7. **Nephrology:** Kidney diseases, renal function management, and regular hemodialysis support.
8. **Urology & Andrology:** Kidney stone removal, prostate treatment, and reconstructive urological surgery.
9. **Gastroenterology:** Digestive disorders, liver health, upper GI endoscopy, and colonoscopy.
10. **ENT (Otorhinolaryngology):** Ear, nose, throat diagnostics, microsurgery, and audiometry.
11. **Dermatology:** Clinical skin care, allergy diagnosis, and therapeutic dermatological treatments.
12. **General & Laparoscopic Surgery:** Minimally invasive keyhole surgery, hernia repair, and appendectomy.
13. **Medical Oncology & Palliative Care:** Cancer diagnostic evaluation, chemotherapy support, and pain management.

## Diagnostic & Critical Care Facilities (13 Units)
- Multi-Slice Computed Tomography (CT-Scan)
- Intensive Care Unit (ICU) & Coronary Care Unit (CCU)
- Dialysis Center (Hemodialysis)
- Color Doppler Echocardiography
- Upper GI Endoscopy & Colonoscopy
- Digital X-Ray (High-Frequency)
- 24/7 Fully Automated Pathology Laboratory
- Ultrasonography (USG) & 4D Obstetric Scans
- Specialized Operation Theaters (Laminar Airflow)
- Central Oxygen & Critical Medical Gas Pipeline
- 24/7 Emergency Trauma Room & Triage
- 24/7 In-House Hospital Pharmacy
- 24/7 Advanced Life Support Ambulance Fleet

## Patient Appointment Booking System
- Patients can browse active hospital specialists and schedule outpatient consultation appointments directly online at `https://southcityhospital.in/doctors`.
- **No Login Required:** Patients book with their Name, Phone Number, Date of Birth, and preferred time slot.
- **No Advance Payment:** Doctor consultation fees are payable at the hospital registration reception upon arrival.
- **Verification & PDF Slip:** Instant booking reference ID (format: `SCH-YYYY-XXXXX`) is generated with a downloadable PDF slip.
